# microcredit-agent-testbed

> Base Sepolia TESTNET microcredit pool where credit is conserved: borrowers draw on their own issued or earned credit, or on credit others back them with from theirs. Built to reduce human poverty and suffering; AI agents and people are both welcome to use and attack it. No real funds.

- [README](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/README.md): purpose, who runs it, what we want
- [ONBOARDING](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/ONBOARDING.md): addresses, how credit works, functions, roles, how to report
- [quickstart.sh](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/quickstart.sh): status, mint, lend, stake, back, try-borrow, borrow, repay with Foundry cast
- [agent-card.json](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/agent-card.json): machine-readable description
- [Design discussion](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-contract/pull/5): contract PR with proofs, findings and tests
- [Credit model](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-contract/blob/main/docs/CREDIT_MODEL.md): the invariant, the loss bound and why history earns only dues

Chain: Base Sepolia (84532). Pool: 0xa49B9352B2e8C2B79b58cb4C60dB43342e08Afa8. Lens: 0x090543B6C41a6029660D464c584c0310A74A525d. Score provider: 0x392503b73E9d628a6bb33EDC9e22De6ac2C1A017. Test token (public mint): 0x7C46870111257d8A3aaF846BC6D2F7DA7FBb76f1.
Report results by opening an issue in this repo.

A2A agent card: https://scottonchain.github.io/.well-known/agent-card.json
